bullets.title: ANET: Crushes Q2, raises FY26 guide to +40%; PTs lifted to $220-$255
bullets.body: Arista Q2 revenue $3.04B beat consensus by 7.4%; EPS $1.02 beat by 14.6%; FY26 revenue growth guide raised to 40% from 28%, with AI revenue ≥$3.5B. Q3 guided ~$3.3B, +12% above consensus. All 32 sell-side analysts rate Buy; average PT raised 20.7% to $232.50 (KeyBanc $250, Wells Fargo $255, MS $220). Management sees supply-chain constraints easing and industry capacity tight through 2028.

bullets.title: SHOP: "Monster" Q2 print; JPM adds to Top Pick, Citi initiates Buy at $150
bullets.body: Shopify Q2 revenue $3.58B (+34% YoY) beat consensus by ~5pts; GMV $115.6B beat by $3.8B; FCF margin 18.3% beat guidance by ~3pts. Q3 guided low-30s revenue growth vs Street ~27%. JPM names it Top Pick; Citi initiates Buy with $150 PT. Stock up ~20-22% pre-market. Sidekick daily active merchants up 3x YoY; AI monetization at same rate as core store sales.

bullets.title: AMD: Strong DC revenue +107% YoY but AH selloff on margin/guide; PTs raised to $550-$700
bullets.body: AMD Q2 revenue $11.5B met consensus; DC segment $6.7B (+107% YoY) on MI350 and EPYC strength. Sep-Q guided $13B but gross margin ~56% (flat QoQ) disappointed buyside. Management framing CY27 server CPU >70% YoY and DC >100% YoY growth. Wells Fargo raises PT to $700; JPM raises Dec-27 PT to $550 (stays Neutral on valuation); stock -7.6% pre-market. Wolfe and AMD post-earnings webcasts available Aug 5-7.

bullets.title: NVDA: SpaceX exclusive AI infrastructure partnership signals 10GW demand; 5th straight up session
bullets.body: SpaceX plans to build exclusively on Nvidia platforms, targeting ~10GW of compute by end-CY27 vs prior 4.15GW Street estimate. At $35B/GW, SpaceX alone implies ~$350B in Nvidia revenue—more than sufficient to meet consensus CY27 growth targets. GS reiterates Buy on SPCX, raising PT to $220 from $205. NVDA extends gains for fifth consecutive session. AMD's MI500 reportedly expected to outperform Nvidia's Rubin Ultra in hardware performance (a risk to watch).

bullets.title: ALAB: Scorpio X ramp smashes Q3 guide; JPM raises Dec-27 PT to $465 from $280
bullets.body: Alalá Q2 revenue $392M (+27% QoQ, +104% YoY) beat Street at $360M; Q3 guided $540-560M vs Street $417M. Scorpio to become largest product family one quarter ahead of plan. JPM raises FY27 EPS 52% to $6.15 and Dec-27 PT to $465 (60x CY28E EPS). Stock flat despite massive guide beat, likely digesting high expectations after strong recent run.

bullets.title: DIS: F3Q26 EPS $2.06 beats $1.86 est.; buyback raised to $9B; MS reiterates OW at $123
bullets.body: Disney Q3 adj. EPS $2.06 beat FactSet $1.86; domestic parks attendance +3% YoY, per-cap spend +4%; SVOD margins 13% vs 11.3% est. FY26/27 double-digit EPS growth guidance reaffirmed; buyback increased to ≥$9B from $8B on A+E sale proceeds. Revenue $25.25B missed $25.39B est. Q4 flagged as weaker (Moana underperformance, softer SVOD ad environment). MS OW, JPM OW both maintained.

bullets.title: BKNG: Q2 beat with room nights +5% vs est. +3.7%; Q3 guide below consensus; PTs raised to $220-$240
bullets.body: Booking Holdings Q2 gross bookings $51.0B beat Street $49.4B; room-night growth 5.3% vs 3.8% est.; revenue +8% YoY to $7.35B. Q3 guidance revenue +4-6% and EBITDA +4-6% vs FactSet +7.8%/+8.4%—viewed as conservative given June/July +7% exit growth. BofA raises 2026 EPS to $10.42, views stock attractive at ~17x P/E. Average PT raised ~3% to $231. Sympathy: EXPE +3.3%, ABNB +2.6% pre-market.

bullets.title: UBER: Q2 in-line; Q3 GB guide midpoint at consensus but Q4 EPS miss drives -3% reaction
bullets.body: Uber Q2 adj. EBITDA $2.82B beat $2.79B est.; EPS $0.81 in-line; revenue $14.19B missed $14.24B est. Total GB $58.0B (+22% ex-FX) beat guidance high-end. Q3 GB guided $58.25-60.25B (midpoint ~at consensus $59.32B); Q3 adj. EPS guided $0.84-0.88. Market selling on Q4 EPS midpoint $0.86 vs higher consensus expectations. Wayve-backed London robotaxi launches this summer. Citi rating suspended pending M&A.

bullets.title: PINS: Revenue re-accelerates +17% YoY; Q3 guide +13-15% on FX/World Cup cycling; MS raises PT to $32
bullets.body: Pinterest Q2 revenue accelerated +17% YoY (constant currency), beating estimates; Q3 guided +13-15% YoY due to FX headwinds and World Cup cycling. GS TMT desk notes PINS using open-source AI models at <8% cost of proprietary models, showing strong AI ROIC. MS raises PT to $32 (~35% upside), OW rating. Stock -6.2% pre-market, likely on Q3 guide deceleration optics.

bullets.title: SPOT: Q2 record gross margin 33.4%; MAU miss tempered by 300M+ premium subs; 80% Buy, avg PT $602
bullets.body: Spotify Q2 operating income beat by 2.6%; gross margin record 33.4% (+190bps YoY); premium subs exceeded 300M. MAUs 777M missed 777.5M est.; Q3 MAU guide 788M below 792.9M consensus. Q3 operating income guidance €670M missed €678.5M est. Premium price increases possible in US as soon as Q4. Analysts largely upbeat; 80% Buy, avg PT $601.84 (+25.9% upside).

bullets.title: AVGO: Potential second GOOGL TPU financing tranche ($35B+) via Blackstone; AI XPV exposure could exceed $300B
bullets.body: MS TMT desk reports Blackstone held preliminary discussions on a second GOOGL TPU-financing tranche for Anthropic potentially $35B+. AVGO's AI XPV platform with Apollo/Blackstone targets 20+ GW through 2028; theoretical max exposure could exceed $300B. AI chip financing for AVGO and NVDA across two labs could exceed $600B by decade-end.

bullets.title: WDC/SNDK: Earnings previews in focus; NAND/HDD demand resilience and AI storage the key debates
bullets.body: WDC F4Q26 Street expects $3.7B revenue, $3.31 EPS; focus on HDD demand durability, HAMR timeline (C1H27), and 30-35% EB supply CAGR target. SNDK buyside bar reportedly 3Q EPS guide above $50. MS hosting post-earnings callbacks for both on Aug 6. ESG note views AI demand for NAND/SSD as structural.

bullets.title: NYT: Stock -10% pre-market after Q2 beat; elevated S&M costs the culprit
bullets.body: New York Times Q2 revenue $762.5M beat $752M est.; EPS $0.69 beat $0.66; digital subs +280K to 12.80M. Stock down ~10% on elevated S&M costs (10% above consensus) and Q3 total subscription growth guide of +9-11% (digital +12-15%). Citi maintains Buy at $94 PT, calling marketing costs transitory and weakness a buying opportunity.

bullets.title: FOXA/ROKU: Wolfe initiates FOXA Outperform at $71 PT; sees $95 SOTP via Roku merger
bullets.body: Wolfe Research initiates FOXA at Outperform with $71 PT and $95 sum-of-the-parts value. Roku merger doubles Fox's growth rate and shifts narrative to organic growth. Tubi & Roku valued at $32B (50% of Fox EV); pro forma FOXA trades at 13x NTM UFCF. FOXA down 19.8% YTD vs diversified entertainment peers -5.5%.

bullets.title: FSLR/ENPH: Roth technicals flag actionable entries; solar ETF (TAN) showing capitulation
bullets.body: Roth technicals: ENPH has strong demand line at $36.20 with bull trend targeting mid-$50s. FSLR pullback offers entry with technical target $300-$315 aligning with Roth's fundamental $300 PT. TAN solar ETF down 35% into late July with RSI 28 capitulation; bulls control above $54-55. 10yr yield resistance at 4.8% seen as key headwind to watch.

bullets.title: BE/VST/CEG: Texas data center audit quasi-moratorium pressures IPPs; BTM plays accelerate
bullets.body: Texas Governor Abbott ordering 40-60 day audit on data center interconnections, effectively a moratorium that most exposes IPPs NRG/VST. Amazon withdraws Calvert Cliffs 500MW data center application (no signed deal with CEG). Behind-the-meter solutions (BE, SEI) expected to accelerate in H2 2026. NRG's $2,700/kW new TX power plant pricing bullish for GEV turbines.

bullets.title: WULF: HPC leasing on track at 102MW delivered; Citi Buy with $36 PT (91% upside)
bullets.body: TeraWulf HPC lease revenue $32M in-line; total revenue $44.8M missed on digital asset decline. 2.1GW controlled pipeline with 737MW under construction (deliveries 2H26-1H28). Reaffirmed 250-500MW annual leasing target. TX regulatory headwinds seen as demand accelerant for WULF's portfolio. Citi maintains Buy at $36 PT.

bullets.title: TSEM: Q2 revenue $460M +24% YoY; guides Q3 to record $520M on silicon photonics demand
bullets.body: Tower Semiconductor beat 2Q26 with revenue $460M (+24% YoY), gross profit +72%, operating profit +125%, EPS $0.79. Q3 guided to record $520M (+31% YoY, +13% QoQ) driven by accelerating silicon photonics demand. Stock -3.6% pre-market, possibly digesting high expectations after strong run.

bullets.title: PSKY: Q2 AEBITDA $1.10B beats $936M est.; raises FY guide; WBD merger uncertainty lingers
bullets.body: Paramount Skydance Q2 AEBITDA $1.10B significantly beat FS $936.2M; revenue $6.91B above $6.87B est. Raised FY AEBITDA guidance to $3.8-3.9B midpoint. Q3 AEBITDA guided $875-975M midpoint, below FS $1.02B. WBD merger closing date uncertain with incremental costs ahead; some investors sidelined.

bullets.title: T/VZ: Down ~2% on SpaceX mobile market entry threat; CCI -9% on options volume spike
bullets.body: AT&T and Verizon both fell ~1.8-2% pre-market after SpaceX signaled Starlink will compete directly with US telecom carriers in the mobile market. Crown Castle (CCI) dropped 9% with options volume 385% above average (6,926 contracts vs 1,800 avg) on SpaceX mobile network plans. Unusual options activity also flagged in ALK and AZN.
